change_summary: Populate few_shot_examples.j2 with a self-contained efficient verify->batch-lookup->confirm->execute exemplar.
reason_for_change: Transcripts show wasted turns/tool calls (task 54: 3 failed lookups; task 23: 4 orders + a product before acting). A compact exemplar demonstrating single verification, targeted batched lookups, and a single confirmation should cut redundant tool calls and turns, lowering mean cost while preserving success. The template is self-contained and never references the undefined example_conversations variable, avoiding the prior preflight rendering crash.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.602140 >= threshold 0.549781 (best mean 0.580574 - 1σ·0.030793)
hypothesis: The agent verifies identity and looks up orders with excessive back-and-forth (task 54 took 3 failed lookups; task 23 fetched 4 orders then a product before acting); a compact few-shot exemplar of an efficient verify->batch-lookup->confirm->execute flow will reduce turns and redundant tool calls — but it must be gated so the template renders safely.
